title: Vijayanagar Foreign Travelers And Their Accounts
definition: A collection of primary historical accounts provided by international visitors (14th-16th century) that serve as the primary source for reconstructing the socio-economic, political, and cultural landscape of the Vijayanagar Empire.
importanceInUpsc: UPSC frequently tests the chronological order of travelers, the specific rulers they visited, and their observations on administrative systems (Nayankara) and social customs (Sati, markets).
learningOutcomes: Master foundational concepts and mechanisms of Vijayanagar Foreign Travelers And Their Accounts.
Evaluate spatial distribution, institutional frameworks, and policy dimensions.
Apply high-yield mnemonics to solve tricky Prelims and Mains questions.
prerequisites: Chronology of Sangama, Saluva, Tuluva, and Aravidu dynasties
Basic understanding of the Nayankara and Ayagar systems
